text.mine-lights.about.title: MineLights
text.mine-lights.about.support_intro: If ye fancy this mod, consider offerin' a bit o' tribute for its makin':
text.mine-lights.about.kofi: Buy me a Grog on Ko-fi
text.mine-lights.about.description: MineLights be a Minecraft mod that brings shinin' RGB lights to the Java Edition seas.
option.mine-lights.enableMod.tooltip: Turns all them shiny lights on or off, savvy?
option.mine-lights.autoStartServer.toolt: If ye hoist this setting, the mod shall launch an installed MineLights Server if it ain't runnin'. With manual server management enabled, ye must install MineLights Server first, matey.
option.mine-lights.manualServerManagemen:
When enabled, th' mod does not download or replace MineLights Server.
It can still start a server ye installed when Automatically Start Server is enabled.
option.mine-lights.notifyMissingServer: Notify when MineLights Server is missing
option.mine-lights.notifyMissingServer.t:
In manual server management mode, shows an in-game installation
message when MineLights Server is missing.
option.mine-lights.checkServerUpdates.to:
In manual server management mode, checks for releases an' shows
new versions an' their changelog in chat. Install updates manually.
option.mine-lights.refresh_devices.label: Count th' Trinkets Anew
option.mine-lights.refresh_devices.toolt:
If ye plug in a new trinket while sailin' th' high seas,
check this and save to make it appear in the manifest.
option.mine-lights.restart.label: Scuttle th' Server!
option.mine-lights.restart_admin.label: Scuttle th' Server... as Cap'n!
option.mine-lights.device.header: Mark which trinkets ye want to enable below, matey:
option.mine-lights.clear_disabled.label: Re-enable All Trinkets
option.mine-lights.clear_disabled.toolti: Check this box to clear the list o' all cursed trinkets.
option.mine-lights.enableSaturationBar.t:
Shows yer food saturation on %s.
Switches to yer air level when underwater.
Change th' keys in Key Chart.
option.mine-lights.enableLocatorBar.tool:
Shows other players an' waypoints in front of ye as coloured dots on %s.
Change th' keys in Key Chart.
option.mine-lights.alwaysShowCompass.too:
If enabled, the star chart will always show the way to the world spawn,
even if ye don't have one.
It'll be overridden if ye pick up any compass.
option.mine-lights.compassPriority.toolt: Decides which star chart to follow if ye have many in yer hold.
option.mine-lights.highlightMovementKeys: Highlights WASD, Sprint, Sneak, an' Jump keys.
option.mine-lights.pulseChatKey.tooltip: When ye spy a missive, the chat key be flashin’ thrice
option.mine-lights.enableBiomeEffects.to: Sets a base keyboard colour based on th' island ye be standin' on.
option.mine-lights.dimmingMode.tooltip: Pick how the world's glow be dulled by the lightin' around ye.
Adds squalls and thunderstorms to yer lights.
option.mine-lights.mirrorRamRainDirectio: Sends the rain animation the other way along yer RAM sticks.
option.mine-lights.enableEndFlashEffect: Enable th' Flash o' th' End
Be showin' ye th' purple flash from th' dark dimension o' th' End.
option.mine-lights.enableInWaterEffect.t: Highlights movement keys with a blue colour when submerged.
option.mine-lights.lodestoneCompassShimm:
Plays the purple shimmer across the compass keys while ye use a lodestone compass.
When off, the keys keep the lodestone colours without the dancin'.
option.mine-lights.force_update.label: Look for New Treasure (Update)
option.mine-lights.force_update.tooltip:
Seek a MineLights Server update on GitHub, matey.
Automatic management can download updates; with manual management, check the chat for installation details.
text.mine-lights.server.restart_from_tra: The shared V2 server serves other clients and software too, matey. Restart it or stop it from its system tray menu.
option.mine-lights.minBrightness.tooltip:
Minimum brightness for environmental effects when dimming is enabled.
0 = completely dark; 1 = full brightness.
text.mine-lights.key_layout.help: Choose which keys each effect lights up. Click "+ Add keys", then press th' keys on yer keyboard in order (th' first key is th' start of th' bar), an' press Esc when ye be done. Changes apply when ye click Save.
option.mine-lights.effectConfigHelp: Enter key names separated by commas an' colours as #RRGGBB. LED overrides use Device name|index=KEY; separate multiple overrides with semicolons. Use none to clear a list or profile.
option.mine-lights.healthBarKeys.tooltip:
Keys that show yer health, from empty to full.
yer 20 health is split evenly across th' keys.
option.mine-lights.hungerBarKeys.tooltip: Keys that show yer hunger, from empty to full.
option.mine-lights.saturationBarKeys.too: Keys that show saturation, or air while underwater.
option.mine-lights.experienceBarKeys.too:
Keys that show progress towards yer next level.
Each key fills up gradually.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatRedKeys.tool:
Keys that pulse like a heartbeat when yer health is low.
Default draws a heart shape in th' middle of th' keyboard.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatWhiteKeys.to:
Keys that pulse white along with th' heartbeat.
Default is th' shine on th' heart (R Y G).
option.mine-lights.compassKeys.tooltip:
Keys around th' compass, clockwise starting from straight ahead.
Usually 8 keys; any number works.
option.mine-lights.compassCenterKey.tool: Key in th' middle of th' compass ring.
option.mine-lights.ledOverrides.tooltip:
Rename LEDs a device reports wrongly.
Format: Device name|LED index=KEY
Example: Keychron|1=F1
Device name matches any device whose name contains it.
LED indexes are in th' game log.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarKeys.toolti:
Keys used for th' locator bar, left to right.
th' middle key is straight ahead; th' ends are 60 degrees to each side.
option.mine-lights.locatorDotSize.toolti:
How many keys a dot bleeds over, for th' closest waypoints.
Farther waypoints get smaller dots, in th' same 4 steps as th' vanilla bar. 0.5 to 5.
option.mine-lights.restoreLightingOutsid:
On th' title screen, while loading, or after quitting,
hand OpenRGB devices back to yer normal lighting.
Off: everything turns red outside of a world.
option.mine-lights.outsideWorldProfile.t:
Name of an OpenRGB profile to load outside of a world
(save one in OpenRGB with yer usual lighting).
Leave blank to restore th' mode each device had when MineLights connected.
option.mine-lights.experienceLocatorMode:
Merged: works exactly like th' bar above yer hotbar. th' keys show
th' experience bar whenever th' screen does (no one tracked, or for a
few seconds after ye gain XP) an' th' locator bar th' rest of th' time.
Both: locator dots are drawn on top of th' experience bar.
option.mine-lights.enableAbsorptionOverl:
Absorption hearts (golden apple, enchanted golden apple, totem)
turn th' health keys gold, from th' start of th' bar,
one key per th' same amount of health as a red key.
option.mine-lights.lowHealthThreshold.to:
th' low health heartbeat starts below this much health.
2 health = 1 heart. Default 10 (5 hearts).
text.mine-lights.keys.none: No keys: this effect won't show anywhere.
text.mine-lights.keys.capturing: Press keys in order, Esc when done: %s
text.mine-lights.keys.unknown: %s isn't a normal key (media keys aren't). If yer keyboard has an Fn key, hold it to press F1-F12.
option.mine-lights.healthBarKeys.descrip: Fills red with yer health; golden hearts turn keys gold. Flashes white when ye be hit, gray when withering, yellow-green when poisoned.
option.mine-lights.hungerBarKeys.descrip: Fills orange with yer food level (20 drumsticks split across th' keys).
option.mine-lights.saturationBarKeys.des: Lime with yer hidden saturation; turns light blue an' shows yer air while yer head is underwater an' until it refills. Not used if saturation is merged into th' hunger bar (Player Status).
option.mine-lights.experienceBarKeys.des: Fills green as ye earn experience an' resets when ye level up.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarKeys.descri: Other players an' waypoints in front of ye show as dots in their own locator bar colour, on a dark bar like in game. Brighter means up, darker means down.
option.mine-lights.locatorDotSize.descri: Bigger dots glow onto more neighboring keys. Like th' vanilla bar, dots shrink in 4 steps between 128 an' 332 blocks away; past that they are a single key.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatRedKeys.desc: Pulses in th' heartbeat colour below th' Low Health Threshold (Player Status). th' default keys form a heart: 4 5 6 7 / E T U / D F H / V B / Space.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatWhiteKeys.de: White shine drawn on top of th' heart while it pulses.
option.mine-lights.compassKeys.descripti: When ye hold a compass, th' key in th' target's direction lights up. Press th' ring keys clockwise starting from th' one for straight ahead. Default: numpad 8 9 6 3 2 1 4 7.
option.mine-lights.compassCenterKey.desc: Shows th' compass colour, an' pulses when ye be within 8 blocks of th' target. Default: numpad 5.
option.mine-lights.ledOverrides.descript: Only needed when a device names an LED wrongly, like a keyboard whose F1 reports as "Brightness Down". LED numbers are in th' game log (logs/latest.log).
text.mine-lights.colors.help: Each bar fades from its empty colour to its full colour as it fills.
option.mine-lights.absorptionColor.toolt: Colour of health keys covered by absorption (golden) hearts.
option.mine-lights.airColor.tooltip: Saturation keys while underwater, for air ye still have.
option.mine-lights.airDimColor.tooltip: Saturation keys while underwater, for air ye have used up.
option.mine-lights.experienceDimColor.to: Experience keys when not filled yet.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatColor.toolti: Colour of th' low health heartbeat at its brightest.
option.mine-lights.saturationTintStrengt:
How much saturation tints th' hunger keys when merged.
0 = no tint, 1 = full saturation colour. Default 0.25.
option.mine-lights.mergeSaturationIntoHu: Merge Saturation & Air into Hunger Bar

Shows saturation an' air on th' hunger keys instead of their own keys.
Saturation tints th' hunger keys it covers (like AppleSkin).
Underwater, an' until yer air refills, th' hunger keys show air instead,
like th' bubbles that appear above th' hunger bar.
th' Saturation / Air keys are left free.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarColor.toolt:
Colour of th' locator keys behind th' waypoint dots
(th' dark bar ye see in game).
option.mine-lights.notifyServerDownloadP: Send word of MineLights Server downloads
Show chat messages when a server download begins whilst ye be in a world, carries on after ye enter a world, and finishes.
message.minelights.server.download.in_pr: [MineLights] The MineLights Server download be still underway.
message.minelights.server.download.finis: [MineLights] The MineLights Server download be finished, and the server has set sail.
[MineLights] The MineLights Server update be finished and the server has restarted.
message.minelights.server.download.resta: [MineLights] The MineLights Server update be verified, but not installed yet. If a MineLights Server be runnin’, stop it from its system tray; then restart Minecraft to install and start the update, matey.
message.minelights.server.download.start: [MineLights] Arrr, MineLights Server could not be started automatically. Start it from its tray or install it by hand: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
message.minelights.server.download.faile: [MineLights] Arrr, automatic MineLights Server setup could not be completed. If it be running, stop it from its tray; otherwise install it by hand: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
message.minelights.server.update_check_f: [MineLights] Arrr, the MineLights Server update check failed. Review updates by hand: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
